xhtml:div.xhtml:div:
SEQUENCE · filled arrow: synchronous call · open arrow: asynchronous message · dashed arrow: reply.
Orange: client/provider · navy: component/service · green: data/cache. Fragments use source predicates; ref expands a subordinate interaction.
Serializable isolation applies to add/remove/reorder. Metadata update is a separate transaction, not described as Serializable.
Add and remove use different predicates; conflict outcomes are not successful replies.
Gateway enrichment is awaited; commands are alternatives, not a mandatory create/add/reorder sequence.

text.tspan: SEQUENCE · filled arrow: synchronous call · open arrow: asynchronous message · dashed arrow: reply.

Serializable isolation applies to add/remove/reorder. Metadata update is a separate transaction, not described as Serializable.
Add and remove use different predicates; conflict outcomes are not successful replies.
